section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: صلاة الساعة التاسعة
text_english: prayer of the ninth hour

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: لشجرة
text_english: the agpeya psalms of the ninth hour are inaudibly distributed on the entire congregation

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: تسبحة الساعة التاسعة من النهار المبارك اقدمها للمسيح ملكي والهي وارجوه ان يغفر لي خطاياي
text_english: the prayer of the ninth hour of this blessed day we offer to christ our king and our god beseeching him to forgive us our sins

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: من مزامير تراتيل معلمنا داود النبي بركاته علي جميعنا امين
text_english: from the psalms of our teacher david the prophet may his blessings be upon us all amen

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: لشجرة
text_english: the following psalms are reserved to be prayed by the priest psalm 95 psalm 109 psalm 115

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور الخامس والتسعون سبحوا الرب تسبيحا جديدا سبحي الرب
text_english: psalm 95 sing to the lord a new song sing to the lord

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: سبحوا الرب تسبيحا جديدا سبحي الرب يا كل الارض سبحوا الرب وباركوا اسمه بشروا من يوم الي يوم بخلاصه حدثوا في الامم بمجده وبين جميع الشعوب بعجائبه لان الرب عظيم هو ومسبح جدا مرهوب علي كل الالهة لان كل الهة الامم شياطين اما الرب فصنع السماوات الجلال والبهاء قدامه الطهر والجمال العظيم في قدسه
text_english: sing to the lord a new song sing to the lord all the earth sing to the lord bless his name proclaim his salvation day to day declare his glory among the gentiles and his wonders among all peoples for the lord is great and greatly praised he is fearsome above all the gods for all the gods of the nations are devils but the lord made the heavens majesty and splendor are before him holiness and great beauty are in his holy

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: قدموا للرب يا جميع قبائل الامم قدموا للرب مجدا وكرامة قدموا للرب مجدا لاسمه احملوا الذبائح وادخلوا دياره اسجدوا للرب في دياره المقدسة فلتتزلزل الارض كلها من امام وجهه قولوا بين الامم ان الرب قد ملك علي خشبة وايضا ثبت المسكونة فلن تتزعزع يدين الشعوب بالاستقامة
text_english: bring to the lord o the families of the gentiles bring to the lord glory and honor bring to the lord the glory to his name carry offerings and go into his court worship the lord in his holy court let all the earth tremble before his face say among the nations “the lord reigned on a wood for he has established the world that it shall not be moved he will judge the peoples in righteousness ”

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: فلتفرح السماوات وتبتهج الارض وليعج البحر وجميع ملئه تفرح البقاع وكل ما فيها حينئذ يبتهج كل شجر الغاب امام وجه الرب انه ياتي ليدين الارض يدين المسكونة بالعدل والشعوب بحقه هللويا
text_english: let the heavens rejoice and the earth exult let the sea roar and its fullness the plains shall rejoice and all things in them then all the trees of the forest shall exult before the face of the lord for he is coming to judge the earth he will judge the world in justice and the peoples with his truth alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور السادس والتسعون الرب قد ملك فلتتهلل الارض
text_english: psalm 96 the lord reigned let the earth exult

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: الرب قد ملك فلتتهلل الارض ولتفرح الجزائر الكثيرة سحاب وضباب حوله العدل والقضاء قوام كرسيه النار تسبق فتسلك امامه وبلهيب تحرق اعداءه الذين حوله اضاءت بروقه المسكونة نظرت الارض فتزلزلت ذابت الجبال مثل الشمع من قدام وجه الرب ومن قدام وجه سيد الارض كلها اخبرت السماوات بعدله وعاينت جميع الشعوب مجده
text_english: the lord reigned let the earth exult let the many islands rejoice clouds and darkness are round about him righteousness and judgment are the uprightness of his throne fire shall precede him and with a flame shall burn up his enemies who surround him his lightings lightened the world the earth saw and trembled the mountains melted like wax before the face of the lord before the face of the lord of the whole earth the heavens have declared his righteousness and all the peoples have seen his glory

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: ليخز جميع الساجدين لصنعة الايدي المفتخرين باصنامهم اسجدوا لله يا جميع ملائكته
text_english: let all those who worship graven images and boast in their idols be ashamed worship him all you his angels

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: سمعت صهيون ففرحت وتهللت بنات يهوذا من اجل احكامك يا رب لانك انت هو الرب العالي علي كل الارض ارتفعت جدا فوق جميع الالهة
text_english: zion heard and rejoiced and the daughters of judea exulted because of your judgments o lord for you are the lord most high over all the earth you are greatly exalted above all gods

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: يا محبي الرب ابغضوا الشر ان الرب يحفظ نفوس ابراره وينجيهم من ايدي الخطاة نور اشرق للصديقين وفرح للمستقيمي القلوب افرحوا ايها الصديقون بالرب واعترفوا لذكر قدسه هللويا
text_english: you who love the lord hate evil the lord preserves the souls of his saints he will deliver them from the hands of the sinners light has shined for the righteous and gladness for the upright in their heart rejoice in the lord you righteous and praise the remembrance of his holiness alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور السابع والتسعون سبحوا الرب تسبيحا جديدا لان الرب
text_english: psalm 97 sing to the lord a new song for the lord

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: سبحوا الرب تسبيحا جديدا لان الرب قد صنع اعمالا عجيبة خلصت له يمينه وذراع قدسه اعلن الرب خلاصه وكشف قدام الامم عدله ذكر رحمته ليعقوب وحقه لبيت اسرائيل نظرت اقاصي الارض جميعها خلاص الهنا
text_english: sing to the lord a new song for the lord has wrought wonderful works his right hand and his holy arm have wrought salvation for him the lord has made known his salvation before the nations he has revealed his righteousness he has remembered his mercy to jacob and his truth to the house of israel the ends of all the earth have seen the salvation of our god

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: هللوا للرب يا كل الارض سبحوا وهللوا ورتلوا رتلوا للرب بالقيثارة بالقيثارة وصوت المزمار بابواق خافقة وصوت بوق القرن هللوا امام الرب الملك فليعج البحر وكل ملئه المسكونة وكل الساكنين فيها تصفق جميع الانهار الجبال تبتهج امام وجه الرب لانه اتي ليدين الارض يدين المسكونة بالعدل والشعوب بالاستقامة هللويا
text_english: shout to the lord all the earth sing and exult and sing psalms sing to the lord with a harp with a harp and a voice of psalm with directed trumpets and a sound of a trumpet of horn shout joyfully before the lord king let the sea roar and its fullness the world and all who dwell in it the rivers shall clap their hands together and the mountains shall exult before the lord for he comes to judge the earth he will judge the world with righteousness and the nations with uprightness alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور الثامن والتسعون الرب قد ملك فلترتعد الشعوب
text_english: psalm 98 the lord reigned let the people rage

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: الرب قد ملك فلترتعد الشعوب الجالس علي الشاروبيم فلتتزلزل الارض عظيم هو الرب في صهيون ومتعال علي كل الشعوب فليعترفوا لاسمه العظيم لانه مرهوب وقدوس وكرامة الملك ان يحب العدل انت هيات الاستقامة انت اجريت القضاء والعدل في يعقوب ارفعوا الرب الهنا واسجدوا لموطئ قدميه فانه قدوس
text_english: the lord reigned let the people rage he who sits upon the cherubim let the earth be shaken the lord is great in zion and is high over all peoples let them confess his great name for it is fearsome and holy and the king s honor loves the judgment you have prepared uprightness you have made judgment and justice in jacob exalt the lord our god and worship at his footstool for he is holy

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: موسي وهرون بين كهنته وصموئيل بين الذين يدعون باسمه كانوا يدعون الرب فيستجيب لهم بعمود الغمام كان يكلمهم لانهم حفظوا شهاداته والاوامر التي اعطاهم ايها الرب الهنا انت استجبت لهم صرت لهم يا الله غفورا ومنتقما علي جميع اعمالهم ارفعوا الرب الهنا واسجدوا في جبله المقدس فان الرب الهنا قدوس هللويا
text_english: moses and aaron among his priests and samuel among those who call upon his name they called upon the lord and he heard them he spoke to them in a pillar of cloud for they kept his testimonies and the ordinances which he gave them o lord our god you answered them o god you became for them a forgiver and an avenger over all their deeds exalt you the lord our god and worship at his holy mountain for the lord our god is holy alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور التاسع والتسعون هللوا للرب يا كل الارض
text_english: psalm 99 shout joyfully to the lord

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: هللوا للرب يا كل الارض اعبدوا الرب بالفرح ادخلوا امامه بالتهليل اعلموا ان الرب هو الهنا هو صنعنا وليس نحن ونحن شعبه وغنم رعيته ادخلوا ابوابه بالاعتراف ودياره بالتسابيح اعترفوا له وباركوا اسمه فان الرب صالح هو والي الابد رحمته والي جيل فجيل حقه هللويا
text_english: shout joyfully to the lord all the earth serve the lord with gladness come into his presence with exultation know that the lord himself is our god he made us and not we ourselves we are his people and the sheep of his pasture enter into his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise give thanks to him praise his name for the lord is good his mercy is forever and his truth is from generation to generation alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور المائة رحمة وحكما
text_english: psalm 100 i will sing of mercy

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: رحمة وحكما اسبحك يا رب اترنم لك واتفهم في طريق بلا عيب متي تاتي الي لقد كنت اسلك بدعة قلبي في وسط بيتي لم اضع امام عيني امرا يخالف الناموس صانعي المعصية ابغضت لم يلتصق بي قلب معوج وعند ميلان الشرير عني لم اكن اعلم والذي يغتاب قريبه سرا كنت اطارده المستكبر بعينيه والمنتفخ القلب لم اواكله
text_english: i will sing of mercy and judgment to you o lord i will sing a psalm and i will have understanding in a blameless way when will you come to me i walked in the innocence of my heart in the midst of my house i have not set before my eyes any unlawful thing i have hated transgressors a perverse heart has not cleaved to me i have not known the evil one forasmuch as he turns away from me he who secretly speaks against his neighbor him i have driven from me he who is proud in his eyes and haughty in heart with him i have not eaten

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: عيناي علي جميع امناء الارض لكي اجلسهم معي السالك في الطريق بلا عيب هذا كان يخدمني المتكبر لم يسكن في وسط بيتي المتكلم بالظلم لم يستقم امام عيني في اوقات الغدوات كنت اقتل جميع خطاة الارض لابيد من مدينة الرب جميع صانعي الاثم هللويا
text_english: my eyes were upon all the faithful of the land that they might sit with me he who walked in a blameless way he ministered to me the proud doer did not dwell in the midst of my house the unjust speaker did not prosper before my eyes in the morning i slew all the sinners of the land that i might wipe out from the city of the lord all who work iniquity alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور المائة والتاسع قال الرب لربي
text_english: psalm 109 the lord said to my lord

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: قال الرب لربي اجلس عن يميني حتي اضع اعداءك تحت موطئ قدميك عصا قوة يرسل لك الرب من صهيون وتسود في وسط اعدائك معك الرئاسة في يوم قوتك في بهاء القديسين من البطن قبل كوكب الصبح ولدتك
text_english: the lord said to my lord “sit on my right hand until i place your enemies under your feet ” a rod of power the lord shall send out for you out of zion and you shall rule in the midst of your enemies with you is dominion in the day of your power in the splendor of the saints from the womb before the morning star i have begotten you

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: اقسم الرب ولن يندم انك انت هو الكاهن الي الابد علي طقس ملكيصادق الرب عن يمينك يحطم في يوم رجزه ملوكا يقضي بين الامم ويملاهم جثثا يسحق راس كثيرين علي الارض وفي الطريق يشرب الماء من الوادي لذلك يرفع راسه هللويا
text_english: the lord has sworn and shall not repent “you are the priest forever after the order of melchizedek ” the lord is at your right hand he shall dash kings in the day of his wrath he shall judge among the nations he shall fill them with dead bodies he shall crush the heads of many on the earth he shall drink of the brook in the way therefore he shall lift up the head alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور المائة والعاشر اعترف لك يارب
text_english: psalm 110 i will give thanks to you

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: اعترف لك يا رب من كل قلبي في مجلس المستقيمين وفي مجمعهم عظيمة هي اعمال الرب ومشيئاته كلها مفحوصة جلال وبهاء عمله وعدله دائم الي ابد الابد ذكر جميع عجائبه رحيم هو الرب ورؤوف اعطي طعاما لاتقيائه يذكر الي الدهر ميثاقه خبر شعبه بقوة اعماله ليعطيهم ميراث الامم
text_english: i will give thanks to you o lord with my whole heart in the council of the upright and in their congregation great are the works of the lord examined are all his wills majesty and splendor are his works and his righteousness endures forever and ever he has made a remembrance of all his wonders the lord is merciful and compassionate he has given food to those who fear him he shall remember his covenant forever he has declared to his people the power of his works to give them the inheritance of nations

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: اعمال يديه حق وعدل كل وصاياه صادقة ثابتة الي دهر الدهور مصنوعة بالحق والاستقامة ارسل خلاصا لشعبه امر بعهده الي الابد اسمه قدوس مرهوب راس الحكمة مخافة الرب والفهم صالح لكل من يعمل به وتسبحته دائمة الي الابد هللويا
text_english: the works of his hands are truth and justice all his commandments are faithful established forever and ever made in truth and uprightness he sent redemption to his people he commanded his covenant forever holy and fearful is his name the fear of the lord is the beginning of wisdom and understanding is good to all who do according to it his praise endures forever and ever alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور المائة والحادي عشر طوبي للرجل الخائف الرب
text_english: psalm 111 blessed is the man

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: طوبي للرجل الخائف الرب ويهوي وصاياه جدا يقوي نسله علي الارض جيل المستقيمين يبارك مجد وغني في بيته وبره يدوم الي الابد نور اشرق في الظلمة للمستقيمين رحيم الرب الاله ورؤوف وبار
text_english: blessed is the man who fears the lord and delights greatly in his commandments his seed shall be mighty in the earth the generation of the upright shall be blessed glory and riches shall be in his house and his righteousness endures forever to the upright light has sprung up in the darkness the lord god is compassionate merciful and righteous

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: صالح هو الرجل الذي يتراءف ويقرض ويدبر اقواله بالحق لانه لا يتزعزع الي الدهر ذكر الصديق يدوم الي الابد ولا يخشي من خبر السوء قلبه مستعد متكل علي الرب قلبه ثابت فلا يتزعزع حتي يري باعدائه فرق واعطي المساكين وبره دائم الي دهر الدهور يرتفع قرنه بالمجد الخاطئ يبصر فيغتاظ ويصر باسنانه ويذوب شهوة الخاطئ تبيد هللويا
text_english: a good man is he who pities and lends he shall direct his words with truth for he shall not be moved forever the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance he shall not be afraid of any evil tidings his heart is ready trusting the lord his heart is established he shall not move till he shall look upon his enemies he has dispersed abroad he has given to the poor his righteousness endures forever and ever his horn shall be exalted with honor the sinner shall see and be angry he shall gnash his teeth and consume away the desire of the sinner shall perish alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور المائة والثاني عشر سبحوا الرب ايها الفتيان
text_english: psalm 112 praise the lord o the servants

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: سبحوا الرب ايها الفتيان سبحوا اسم الرب ليكن اسم الرب مباركا من الان والي الابد من مشارق الشمس الي مغاربها باركوا اسم الرب الرب عال علي كل الامم وفوق السماوات مجده
text_english: praise the lord o the servants praise the name of the lord let the name of the lord be blessed from now and forever from the risings of the sun to its settings praise the name of the lord the lord is high above all the nations upon the heavens is his glory

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: من مثل الرب الهنا الساكن في الاعالي والناظر الي المتواضعين في السماء وعلي الارض المقيم المسكين من التراب والرافع البائس من المزبلة لكي يجلسه مع رؤساء شعبه الذي يجعل العاقر ساكنة في بيت وام اولاد فرحة هللويا
text_english: who is like the lord our god who dwells in the high places and looks upon the low things in heaven and on the earth who lifts up a poor person from the earth and raises up a needy person from the ash heap to seat him with the princes even with the princes of his people who makes a barren woman in a house rejoicing as a mother of children alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور المائة والرابع عشر احببت ان يسمع الرب
text_english: psalm 114 i loved because the lord

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: احببت ان يسمع الرب صوت تضرعي لانه امال اذنه الي فادعوه كل ايامي لان اوجاع الموت اكتنفتني وشدائد الجحيم اصابتني ضيقا وحزنا وجدت وباسم الرب دعوت يارب نج نفسي
text_english: i loved because the lord will hear the voice of my supplication because he has inclined his ear to me i will call upon him in all my days the pains of death grasped me the dangers of hades have found me i found affliction and sorrow then i called on the name of the lord “o lord deliver my soul ”

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: الرب رحيم وصديق والهنا يرحم الذي يحفظ الاطفال هو الرب اتضعت فخلصني
text_english: the lord is merciful and righteous and our god has mercy the lord preserves the infants i was brought low and he saved me

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: ارجعي يا نفسي الي موضع راحتك لان الرب قد احسن الي وانقذ نفسي من الموت وعيني من الدموع ورجلي من الزلل ارضي الرب امامه في كورة الاحياء هللويا
text_english: return to your resting place o my soul for the lord has dealt bountifully with you he has delivered my soul from death my eyes from tears and my feet from falling i shall be pleasing before the lord in the land of the living alleluia

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: المزمور المائة والخامس عشر امنت لذلك تكلمت
text_english: psalm 115 i believed therefore i have spoken

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
text_arabic: امنت لذلك تكلمت وانا اتضعت جدا انا قلت في حيرتي ان كل الناس كاذبون بماذا اكافئ الرب عن كل ما اعطانيه كاس الخلاص اخذ وباسم الرب ادعو اوفي نذوري للرب قدام كل شعبه
text_english: i believed therefore i have spoken i was exceedingly humbled i said in my amazement “every man is a liar ” what shall i render to the lord for everything which he has done unto me i shall take the cup of salvation and call upon the name of the lord i will pay my vows to the lord in the presence of all his people

section: pascha/saturday/Vigil of the Apocalypse - Ninth Hour
